mentions.note: twice broke club 1500m record; 2nd Golden Jubilee Cup Final 1500m

mentions.h: A dominating win in the semi

photos.c: Bottom right: One of Belgrave's growing band of middle distance runners, Julie Mitchell twice broke the club record for 1500m (although that record is now owned by Catherine Berry). Julie placed 2nd in the Golden Jubilee Cup Final 1500m.
